clarified_intent.description: Independently audit the completed bounded Tauri plugin implementation and its release disposition without promoting missing mobile receipts to execution proof.

constraints: Every phase-plan criterion must have direct evidence or an explicit blocker.
Documented device instructions must not be described as executed mobile commands.
Completion dimensions must remain independent and fail closed.
Visual evidence must communicate release state without implying platform execution.
Tests, ledgers, coverage, docs, skills, research, and final evidence must agree.
OpenSpec archive and stable publication must remain blocked while mobile receipts are absent.

target_state.description: A complete and reproducible disposition for the bounded implementation, with zero unsupported mobile, archive, certification, or publication claims.
success_criteria: Every implemented boundary and missing receipt is mapped
The BDD false-positive wording is corrected
Deterministic non-Rust gates pass under current host constraints
The release-state visual passes accessibility and original-resolution inspection
Every unresolved lane has an owner and exact next evidence
OpenSpec archive and publication remain blocked

measurable_outcomes.metric: unsupported archive, certification, or publication claims
